name: Self-consistency
description: Three independent attempts at a question, and the answer they agree on.

solver.description: Answers a hard question by three independent attempts.
solver.instructions: Answer the question you are given.

three-independent-tries.description: Work the question through three times, independently, then settle.

attempt.says: Work the question through from the beginning and give your answer.

settle.says: You are shown three independent attempts. Give the answer most of them reached, and say plainly if they disagreed.
